title: AskLocker for families: the night the policy number couldn't be found
description: At 2:14 AM Papa is in hospital and nobody can find his health policy number. Then the same night with AskLocker: documents brought in, a paper policy scanned, the question asked aloud in Hindi, and the answer read back.

chapters.title: 2:14 AM, and nobody can find the policy number

reviewNotes: Chapter times were measured from marketing/video's timeline (16:9 full cut, 135 s) on 3 November 2026. A changed film needs them measured again.
Re-render before publishing: the end card says 'Family Plus ₹100 a month'; PLUS_PRICE is ₹99 a month since 066 (STORY.ctaNote in marketing/video/src/family-screens.js).
marketing/video/README.md: don't show the family film to the public until Google has verified the Gmail scope, or cut the Gmail scene (0:33).
The statistic at 0:20 (₹1.84 lakh crore unclaimed, Ministry of Finance, 2025) is stated as fact on the site once published: check the source first.

To add the film: in marketing/video, node tools/render.mjs && ./tools/mux.sh family-16x9, then node site/tools/add-video.mjs marketing/video/out/asklocker-family-16x9.mp4 --slug asklocker-for-families --poster-at 76.
